issues: Food cost and labour both ran elevated, attributed to ongoing promotional campaigns.
A two star Google review was received about watery sushi rice; the kitchen attributed it to ambient temperature, which was not accepted, and corrective follow up is required.
Approval was given to place additional backup stock orders ahead of the Fresh Fair event the following week.

Deliveroo order accuracy is worse than acceptable, with three refunds in the week covering a missing yasai roll, a katsu curry supplied with only one boiled egg after an extra was paid for, and a missing salmon avocado roll, all disputed by the site.
Deliveroo prep time has increased although it remains within range.
A bad batch of avocados was received from the supplier.
The candy floss used on cocktails sets solid faster than it can be delivered to the table, and one customer accepted the drink after being told the garnish was unavailable.
Labour ran high because of two student fairs held on 07/09/2026 and 09/09/2026.
The air conditioning has been out of service for around a year, needs full replacement, is rated ultra high priority and has still not been logged as a job.
The front door fault has not yet been logged as a job, and the disabled lift fault has been logged.
Back of house and front of house are settled, one team member is being trained towards supervisor level, and no recruitment is currently open.
Freshers fairs run the following week and a home match falls on 19/09/2026 at 15:00.

Region-wide (Scotland & Newcastle): Following a Char Siu quality problem traced to the supplier, all sites must stay vigilant when opening new Char Siu deliveries, carry out random quality checks and test product quality before serving.

Region-wide (Scotland & Newcastle): Frozen ramen, ramen bowls and inner containers are to be ordered exclusively from JFC, while takeaway packaging remains with Lynas because of JFC packaging quality inconsistencies.
Region-wide (Scotland & Newcastle): The weekly BOH KPI meeting reverts to its regular Tuesday 10:30 slot, with the next one on 22/09/2026.
